title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along walkable corridors between Kalamazoo College and downtown, each paired with one practical, sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: See the hilltop castle
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street — historic architecture beside campus
cards.notes: Walk north on Monroe Street to view the castle’s distinctive exterior from the public approach; contact the property before planning an interior visit.
cards.short_summary: A named historic-looking landmark immediately north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College lists Henderson Castle at 100 Monroe Street among local lodging options.
cards.access_notes: The cited page verifies the property and address but not public exterior-viewing or tour hours; contact the property before entering.

cards.title: Pause for a café break
cards.subtitle: West Lovell Street — coffee near the downtown approach
cards.notes: Turn onto West Lovell Street for a café stop before continuing east; check the business directly for current service hours and ordering details.
cards.short_summary: A downtown coffee address on the route from campus toward the mall.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College lists Factory Coffee at 205 W. Lovell Street in its current brunch-and-cafés guide.
cards.source_title: Local Restaurants and Bars – Homecoming and Reunions
cards.access_notes: Purchase is required for café items; confirm current hours with the business before visiting.

cards.title: Choose a gallery hour
cards.subtitle: South Park Street — visual arts on the downtown route
cards.notes: Follow South Park Street to the museum and review the current exhibitions first; Thursday offers extended hours and free general admission.
cards.short_summary: A visual-arts museum with galleries and a documented student rate.
cards.evidence_claim: The KIA is at 314 S. Park Street and lists galleries, regular admission prices, and free general admission on Thursdays.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit to the KIA
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday; Thursday hours extend to 8 p.m. Regular college-student admission is $7, while Thursday general admission is free.

cards.title: Spot the copper-roofed venue
cards.subtitle: South Park Street — community theatre architecture
cards.notes: Continue along South Park Street to identify the Civic’s copper-roofed building; consult its schedule before planning to attend a performance.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable community-theatre venue on the civic-district edge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kalamazoo Civic Theatre identifies its venue at 329 S. Park Street and notes that its copper roof was replaced in 2018.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing does not establish building access; consult the theatre’s current schedule and ticket information before entering.

cards.title: Cross the downtown civic green
cards.subtitle: South Rose Street — public park in the civic district
cards.notes: Use South Rose Street to reach the central green, then orient yourself among the surrounding civic buildings before continuing downtown.
cards.short_summary: A named city park anchoring Kalamazoo’s downtown civic district.
cards.evidence_claim: City of Kalamazoo project documents identify Bronson Park at 200 South Rose Street.
cards.source_title: Bronson Park Audio Upgrade – Project Manual
cards.access_notes: The city document verifies the park and address but does not provide current public-use hours; follow posted park rules.

cards.title: Use the downtown library
cards.subtitle: South Rose Street — public reading and research stop
cards.notes: Continue on South Rose Street for a reading or research break; review the posted daily schedule because the Central Library closes on Sundays.
cards.short_summary: The central public-library building with verified weekly hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo Public Library places the Central Library at 315 S. Rose Street and publishes its current Monday-through-Saturday hours.
cards.source_title: Getting Here: CEN — Kalamazoo Public Library
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8 p.m., Friday 9 a.m.–6 p.m., and Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Enter a free museum
cards.subtitle: North Rose Street — exhibits without general admission
cards.notes: Head north on Rose Street and set aside time for the museum’s exhibits; general admission is free, though special programs may differ.
cards.short_summary: A downtown museum operated by Kalamazoo Valley Community College.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kalamazoo Valley Museum states that general admission is free and gives its address as 230 North Rose Street.
cards.access_notes: General admission is free. Check the museum’s current calendar and visit information for program-specific schedules or charges.

cards.title: Stop for Mexican food
cards.subtitle: West Michigan Avenue — downtown meal option
cards.notes: Follow West Michigan Avenue to the café when you want a meal downtown; verify the day’s service before relying on the listed noon opening.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican café identified by the college in its downtown dining guide.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College lists La Familia Café at 224 W. Michigan Avenue as a Mexican dining option.
cards.access_notes: The college guide lists service from noon to 8 p.m.; confirm current daily hours with the café. Food purchases are required.

cards.title: Take a daytime meal break
cards.subtitle: West Michigan Avenue — breakfast and lunch downtown
cards.notes: Continue along West Michigan Avenue for a daytime breakfast or lunch stop; arrive before midafternoon based on the college’s listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College lists Studio Grill at 312 W. Michigan Avenue as an American breakfast and brunch restaurant.
cards.access_notes: The college guide lists 7:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; confirm current daily hours with the restaurant. Food purchases are required.

cards.title: Follow Water Street for coffee
cards.subtitle: East Water Street — café near the downtown core
cards.notes: Walk east along Water Street for coffee, snacks, or a light meal; check current hours before making it the final stop of your route.
cards.short_summary: A downtown café and deli on its namesake street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College lists Water Street Coffee Joint at 315 E. Water Street as a café and deli serving beverages, snacks, and meals.
cards.access_notes: The college guide lists 6:30 a.m.–8 p.m.; confirm current daily hours with the café. Purchases are required.
